# Mohammad Danish Siddiqui

> Senior frontend engineer ({{ site.brand.years-experience }}+ years) and CDI Certified Resume Analyst based in Milton, Ontario, Canada. Founder of HireDoc. Helps internationally trained software engineers already living in Canada or the United States turn a stalled job search into interviews.

Mohammad Danish Siddiqui (often "Danish Siddiqui") works in two lanes. As an engineer he specializes in React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, with backend depth in GraphQL, Python and Django. As a CDI Certified Resume Analyst he has reviewed {{ site.brand.resumes-reviewed }}+ resumes for internationally trained software engineers and built HireDoc, an interview-based resume tool.

## Core position

The North American market reads resumes differently than services markets do. Elsewhere, a resume records responsibilities and tenure; in Canada and the US, recruiters screen for business impact — scale, ownership, architecture decisions, and measurable outcomes. A strong engineer with a poorly positioned resume routinely loses to an average engineer who communicates value clearly. The bottleneck for most stalled job searches is representation, not skill.
